title: Front-End Developer
description:
Structure: 3 days in office and 2 WFH

Company: AB Software Solutions

Salary: £30,000 - £40,000

We are pleased to inform that AB Software Solution in Luton is hiring a front-end developer. The post is currently available. This is a varied, challenging Full Stack Developer role with a leaning towards the frontend. You’ll be responsible for designing & developing, user-friendly, responsive frontend interfaces and implementing scalable backend systems and APIs

Essential:

  • At least 3yrs development experience
  • Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
  • Front end frameworks/libraries (Angular, React, Vue.js etc.)
  • Experience in C# .Net
  • SQL Server

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the development of software solutions using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
  • Collaborate with senior developers and team members to design and implement software features.
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
  • Debug and troubleshoot software issue
